name: Grain
shortDescription: Grain can record a customer call.
longDescription: Grain can record a customer call. It can also share a meeting moment.
freeTierNotes: A free option is mentioned on the site.
notIdealFor: A task outside the jobs described on the official site
Someone who wants the work finished by hand with no software
strength: Grain can record a customer call for this kind of work.
weakness: You still review the output before a customer or client sees it.
capabilities: capture rules type notes, tag important moments, or clip segments to perfect a insights during a meeting
capture rules set rules for which meetings get recorded, so everything you want is captured without thinking about it
